sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_of_birth" TEXT NULL, "height_mm" INTEGER NULL CHECK("height_mm" BETWEEN 300 AND 3000), "weight_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("weight_unit" IN ('kg', 'lb')), "length_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("length_unit" IN ('cm', 'in')), "volume_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("volume_unit" IN ('ml', 'fl_oz')), "distance_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("distance_unit" IN ('km', 'mi')), "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "wake_time" TEXT NULL, "workout_days" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "custom_measurement_types" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "onboarding_completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_weight_g" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_weight_g" > 0), "daily_steps" INTEGER NULL CHECK("daily_steps" >= 0), "daily_water_ml" INTEGER NULL CHECK("daily_water_ml" >= 0), "sleep_target_min" INTEGER NULL CHECK("sleep_target_min" BETWEEN 0 AND 1440), "fitness_goals" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nutrition_goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "energy_kcal_milli" INTEGER NULL CHECK("energy_kcal_milli" >= 0), "protein_mg" INTEGER NULL CHECK("protein_mg" >= 0), "carbs_mg" INTEGER NULL CHECK("carbs_mg" >= 0), "fat_mg" INTEGER NULL CHECK("fat_mg" >= 0), "fibre_mg" INTEGER NULL CHECK("fibre_mg" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weight_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "weight_g" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("weight_g" BETWEEN 1000 AND 700000), "entry_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("entry_unit" IN ('kg', 'lb')), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "enqueued_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("entity_table", "entity_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_measurements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "measurement_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("value_milli" > 0), "unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("unit" IN ('cm', 'percent')), "entry_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("entry_unit" IN ('cm', 'in', 'percent')), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "water_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "amount_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_ml" BETWEEN 1 AND 5000), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "serving_label" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("serving_qty_milli" > 0), "serving_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_weight_mg" INTEGER NULL, "energy_kcal_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("energy_kcal_milli" >= 0), "protein_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("protein_mg" >= 0), "carbs_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("carbs_mg" >= 0), "fat_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("fat_mg" >= 0), "fibre_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("fibre_mg" >= 0), "junk_category" TEXT NULL CHECK("junk_category" IS NULL OR "junk_category" IN ('fast_food', 'fried_snacks', 'sweets', 'sugary_drinks', 'packaged_snacks', 'other')), "is_saved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_saved" IN (0, 1)), "use_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_used_at" TEXT NULL, "catalogue_ref" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "meal_category" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("meal_category" IN ('early_morning', 'breakfast', 'mid_morning', 'lunch', 'evening_snack', 'dinner', 'late_night', 'other')), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "has_photo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_photo" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_food_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "meal_log_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meal_logs (id), "food_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES food_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "food_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("quantity_milli" > 0), "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_weight_mg" INTEGER NULL, "energy_kcal_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("energy_kcal_milli" >= 0), "protein_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("protein_mg" >= 0), "carbs_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("carbs_mg" >= 0), "fat_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("fat_mg" >= 0), "fibre_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("fibre_mg" >= 0), "junk_category" TEXT NULL CHECK("junk_category" IS NULL OR "junk_category" IN ('fast_food', 'fried_snacks', 'sweets', 'sugary_drinks', 'packaged_snacks', 'other')), "item_notes" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_category" TEXT NULL CHECK("meal_category" IS NULL OR "meal_category" IN ('early_morning', 'breakfast', 'mid_morning', 'lunch', 'evening_snack', 'dinner', 'late_night', 'other')), "items" TEXT NOT NULL, "use_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_used_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sleep_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('night', 'nap')), "start_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_s" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("duration_s" BETWEEN 60 AND 86400), "quality" INTEGER NULL CHECK("quality" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "notes" TEXT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_health_checkins" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "energy" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("energy" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "mood" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("mood" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "stress" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("stress" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "wellness" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("wellness" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_food_catalogue" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_label" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_weight_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL, "energy_kcal_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "protein_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL, "carbs_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fat_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fibre_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_estimate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_estimate" IN (0, 1)), "household_label" TEXT NULL, "household_weight_mg" INTEGER NULL, "has_conflict" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_conflict" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_meal_photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_log_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "taken_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_definitions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "tracking_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("tracking_type" IN ('boolean', 'count', 'numeric', 'duration', 'stopwatch', 'event_log', 'checklist')), "priority" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("priority" IN ('essential', 'optional')), "target_milli" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_milli" IS NULL OR "target_milli" > 0), "target_unit" TEXT NULL, "schedule" TEXT NOT NULL, "schedule_history" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "stopwatch_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("stopwatch_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "show_on_dashboard" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_on_dashboard" IN (0, 1)), "checklist_items" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('active', 'archived')), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "system_key" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "activity_definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_definitions (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('completed', 'skipped')), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_slot" INTEGER NULL CHECK("scheduled_slot" IS NULL OR "scheduled_slot" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "count_value" INTEGER NULL CHECK("count_value" IS NULL OR "count_value" >= 0), "numeric_value_milli" INTEGER NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "duration_s" INTEGER NULL CHECK("duration_s" IS NULL OR "duration_s" BETWEEN 0 AND 86400), "checklist_state" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("source" IN ('manual', 'notification', 'timer')), "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_timer_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('stopwatch', 'countdown', 'rest')), "activity_definition_id" TEXT NULL, "workout_session_id" TEXT NULL, "target_duration_s" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_duration_s" IS NULL OR "target_duration_s" BETWEEN 1 AND 86400), "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("state" IN ('ready', 'running', 'paused', 'completed', 'cancelled')), "accumulated_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_resumed_at" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "activity_log_id" TEXT NULL, "notification_id" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_timer_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_timer_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("type" IN ('start', 'pause', 'resume', 'finish', 'cancel')), "at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('custom', 'activity', 'water', 'workout', 'sleep', 'posture')), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "activity_definition_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES activity_definitions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "schedule" TEXT NOT NULL, "condition" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("condition" IN ('always', 'if_incomplete')), "channel_key" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("channel_key" IN ('alarms', 'routines', 'hydration', 'fitness', 'medication', 'sleep', 'system')), "sound_key" TEXT NULL, "vibrate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("vibrate" IN (0, 1)), "snooze_default_min" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10 CHECK("snooze_default_min" BETWEEN 1 AND 720), "priority" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("priority" IN ('normal', 'alarm')), "quiet_hours_behaviour" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("quiet_hours_behaviour" IN ('defer', 'suppress', 'bypass')), "exact" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exact" IN (0, 1)), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "start_date" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_notification_state" ("notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reminder_store" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("reminder_store" IN ('main', 'private')), "reminder_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurrence_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurrence_local" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("mode" IN ('exact', 'inexact')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('scheduled', 'snoozed', 'completed', 'skipped', 'dismissed', 'cancelled', 'expired')), "deferred" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deferred" IN (0, 1)), "snooze_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "acted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("notification_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "step_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "log_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "steps" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("steps" >= 0), "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("source" IN ('phone_sensor', 'phone_sensor_adjusted', 'manual')), "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "collected_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("log_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "muscle_group" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NOT NULL, "instructions" TEXT NULL, "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "measurement_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("measurement_kind" IN ('weight_reps', 'reps_only', 'duration', 'distance_duration')), "system_key" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('gym', 'walk', 'run', 'cycle')), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "duration_s" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("duration_s" BETWEEN 0 AND 86400), "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "distance_m" INTEGER NULL CHECK("distance_m" IS NULL OR "distance_m" BETWEEN 0 AND 500000), "steps" INTEGER NULL, "entry_mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("entry_mode" IN ('manual', 'gps')), "has_route" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_route" IN (0, 1)), "template_id" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "workout_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_exercises (id), "set_number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("set_number" >= 1), "reps" INTEGER NULL CHECK("reps" IS NULL OR "reps" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000), "load_g" INTEGER NULL CHECK("load_g" IS NULL OR "load_g" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000), "entry_unit" TEXT NULL CHECK("entry_unit" IS NULL OR "entry_unit" IN ('kg', 'lb')), "distance_m" INTEGER NULL CHECK("distance_m" IS NULL OR "distance_m" BETWEEN 0 AND 500000), "duration_s" INTEGER NULL CHECK("duration_s" IS NULL OR "duration_s" BETWEEN 0 AND 86400), "rest_s" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rest_s" IS NULL OR "rest_s" BETWEEN 0 AND 3600), "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercises" TEXT NOT NULL, "use_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_used_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_step_readings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "cumulative_steps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "boot_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "elapsed_realtime_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "wall_time_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "utc_offset_s" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("source" IN ('service', 'worker', 'foreground', 'shutdown', 'boot', 'time_change')), UNIQUE ("boot_count", "elapsed_realtime_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_step_daily" ("local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "sensor_steps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "manual_adjustment" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "uncertain_steps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "gap_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_collected_at" TEXT NULL, "computed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_workout_route_points" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lat_e7" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lon_e7" INTEGER NOT NULL, "accuracy_dm" INTEGER NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_recovery_logs" ("local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_rest_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_rest_day" IN (0, 1)), "soreness" INTEGER NULL, "recovery" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_sync_cursors" ("table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor_ts" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_pulled_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("table_name"));
CREATE INDEX weight_logs_local_date ON weight_logs (local_date)
CREATE INDEX body_measurements_type_date ON body_measurements (measurement_type, local_date)
CREATE INDEX water_logs_local_date ON water_logs (local_date)
CREATE INDEX food_items_name ON food_items (name)
CREATE INDEX meal_logs_local_date ON meal_logs (local_date)
CREATE INDEX meal_food_items_meal ON meal_food_items (meal_log_id)
CREATE INDEX sleep_logs_local_date ON sleep_logs (local_date)
CREATE INDEX daily_health_checkins_local_date ON daily_health_checkins (local_date)
CREATE INDEX local_food_catalogue_name ON local_food_catalogue (name)
CREATE INDEX activity_logs_local_date ON activity_logs (local_date)
CREATE INDEX activity_logs_definition ON activity_logs (activity_definition_id, local_date)
CREATE INDEX local_timer_events_session ON local_timer_events (session_id)
CREATE INDEX local_notification_state_reminder ON local_notification_state (reminder_id, occurrence_local)
CREATE INDEX local_notification_state_at ON local_notification_state (occurrence_at)
CREATE INDEX workout_sessions_local_date ON workout_sessions (local_date)
CREATE INDEX workout_exercises_session ON workout_exercises (session_id)
CREATE INDEX exercise_sets_workout_exercise ON exercise_sets (workout_exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX local_step_readings_time ON local_step_readings (wall_time_utc)
CREATE INDEX local_workout_route_points_session ON local_workout_route_points (session_id)
